scope: Implemented bounded native raw-text streaming scheduling with per-request resource quotes, FIFO admission, one-request round-robin forward turns, continuous arrivals/refill and fenced cancellation. The encoded-token BF16 batching runtime remains separate and unchanged. This is not multi-request GPU matrix batching or production vLLM parity.

interface.backend: plan/acquire/release/time_ms callbacks. Plan precedes allocation; each distinct lease supplies an independently prepared session and disjoint tokenizer workspace. Backend model and immutable tokenizer/JSON ownership stay outside orchestration.
interface.execution: One native request attempt per turn, round robin even after BUSY; preserve each configured prefill chunk and committed/prediction policy. Live allocations stay charged through release callback. Normal completion releases healthy state; cancellation and errors discard/fence partial state before refund/terminal notification. Permanent perrequest failures do not stop healthy peers; invalid ownership or clock poisons all pending requests.
interface.metrics: Counters and monotonic arrival/admission/firsttoken/firstbyte/terminal timestamps; firsttoken includes empty chunks, firstbyte requires data including final flush. enqueue_at preserves externally recorded queue delay. Terminal notification/timestamp follow cleanup. Read-only info reentry allowed; mutation/free reentry rejected; initialized handle copy rejected.

admission.scope: Active quoted request payload in device/host/pinned dimensions, checked independently with overflow-safe available-budget comparisons; maxlive and queue capacity are separate bounds.
admission.exclusions: Not a total physical VRAM/RSS cap: immutable model, shared expert/row caches, allocator/context overhead and independently budgeted retained idle pool/verification owners are separate. Temporary probe always frees each leased session on return.
admission.probe_quote: Conservative sum of all native FFN/KV/SWA/index/attention/producer/rows/Engram/HC/head plan payloads, history, session logits/raw history arena and maximum mutable tokenizer scratch/token/piece buffers. Common max2048/context2304; one-budget mode admits only1 despite maxlive2.
admission.allocation: One fixed orchestration allocation at init, no perqueue/perturn/percancel allocations. ASAN unit scheduler drains deny heap operations with nonallocating backend stubs; actual backend admission and user callbacks retain their own budgets.

qualification.scope: Bounded native streaming scheduler, charged leases until fenced release, continuous arrivals/replacement, normal and partial CUDA BUSY cancellation, full order/mode normal cross product, source-exact completions, ASAN/CUDA tools/legacy/Qwen compatibility

source_scope.comparison: Every actual encoded/forward ID, every published last F32 vocabulary word, generated ID, counted UTF8 chunk/order/full bytes and final position compare exactly to unchanged original sources. Normal cancelled requests publish one exact source prefill and zero outputs. Source metadata sorting handles arbitrary completion order.
source_scope.workload: Normal scheduler AB/BA x committed/prediction, two cycles skip0/1; initial0/1/2, cancel0, enqueue replacement4 and later-arriving3. Four completions and one cancellation per cycle, five acquired/released sessions, FIFO admissions0/1/2/4/3. Peak2 or1 under budget pressure.
source_scope.profile: Explicit Diffbot INT4 BF16 lookup to Exllama F16 Engram source adapter, not unmodified Diffbot whole-runtime equivalence.

busy_fault.method: Temporary qualification harness returns BN_GPU_UPLOAD_BUSY at upload-acquire2 after a real CUDA embedding launch has queued work; no artificial synchronization is inserted. Assert actual encoded prompt equals preserved Rust IDs and native history committed0/staged>0, no full-forward or output publication. Cancel through the public scheduler; destroy proxy proves target request teardown before refund. Surviving and replacement sessions complete source-exactly.
busy_fault.scope: Controlled legal BUSY at backend upload boundary, not natural device congestion; hook never enters library/default code. ASAN host checks and CUDA memcheck/initcheck separately qualify injected partial cleanup. No numerical oracle changes.

tools.synthetic: Original672 blocking/resumable source-success cases plus all3 budgets, FIFO/round-robin/BUSY/reentry, dynamic arrivals, staged discard, isolated failure, duplicate-lease poison exactlyonce cleanup, clock failure, invalidUTF8, oversize/noacquire, temporary plan/acquire exhaustion, zero-output, bounded queue and borrowed ownership.
tools.asan: New generation object/implementation and harness/tests instrumented; retained tokenizer/JSON/bridge/host-cache ASAN objects, other unchanged runtime/GPU objects normal. No whole-runtime ASAN claim.
tools.cuda: Injected partial-BUSY cancellation under memcheck AB committed and initcheck BA prediction, four completed source requests each, zero errors. No racecheck claim.
tools.compatibility: Old blocking long/short/512 controls, legacy native14 checks and fresh Qwen27 strict192/192.
tools.reference_audit: All content hashes and all parallel futures checked; user4 binaries restored/preserved; only six intentional source paths and actual compiler outputs repinned. Numerical references unchanged.

resolved_prequalification_issues: Four misleading-indentation warnings in new test helper were fixed before final clean build.
Generated standalone probe initially used Python-interpreted C newlines; generator changed to raw C body, archived failed artifacts, final links zero warnings before freeze.

Initial freeze missed a .cc compiler echo attached to a parallel test-progress dot (test_coherence). Compiler allowlist parser now strips leading progress dots; actual output repinned, all hashes pass. No model or source oracle failure.

First numerical qualification stopped at the injected probe: upload32 occurred after earlier forwards, invalidating its assumed zero committed position. No library change or numerical oracle edit; injection moved to the second acquire with a witnessed real embedding launch, retaining strict committed0/staged/no-output assertions. Original attempt archived, a fresh corrected preflight and full qualification performed.
limits: This schedules one request-forward attempt per caller turn. Multi-request GEMM and concurrent GPU overlap throughput are not qualified. No kernel preemption or wall-time bound; a large prefill attempt can still delay decode.

Production backend adapter/service/CLI and a reusable request-sized native KV pool are not shipped by this component; backend quote/acquire/release contracts are public, temporary real-weight adapter is a qualification artifact. Existing BF16 packed batching/pool paths unchanged.
Two related prompts, five generated tokens and prepared maximum2304 context; broader domains, longer generations, larger concurrency and naturally occurring BUSY/driver failures remain to qualify.
Source checking performs file I/O and copies reference logits in callbacks. Event times here validate semantics only; they are not throughput, tail-latency or vLLM performance evidence.
Shared model/cache and context/allocator/idle resources need separate budgets; quoted lease counters do not prove total physical memory bounds.
No new ARM/Metal runtime qualification, all-model completion, fully resident matched vLLM result or default-path acceleration claim.
